peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 5.3% above its local comparables; 40 of 54 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (5.5): 1.8 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 5 of 91 similar developments with a figure. Context, not scored: resales in 50% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $1,635,000 ($1,321 psf, 1,227–1,237 sq ft; 6 resales, Aug 2025–Jul 2026); 5 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,255 psf (range $1,193–1,401); 5.3% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $82,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Tampines West MRT about 1,260 m, Bedok Reservoir MRT about 1,510 m; closer than 12 of 94 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest ST. Hilda's Primary School about 1,090 m; more than 0 of 94 similar developments (the same as 18). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 750 m), more than 22 of 94 similar developments (the same as 12); nearest hawker centre Hawker Centre @ Our Tampines Hub about 1,540 m; nearest park Bedok Reservoir Park about 260 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (Pinery Residences, 552 new sales, about 1,430 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 20 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,108 new sales and 400 resales (1,508 purchases); new sales were 73.5% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 400 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 38 of 94 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 400 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 497 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−19.5%). Planning-area private resales −24.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
